business_problem: Warehouse owners had unused space while small businesses struggled to find suitable short-term warehouse capacity. Manual vetting, matching, and negotiation made the marketplace slow to operate; a typical search could take 18 months.
solution_summary: Warehouse Exchange uses an agent-based marketplace to match warehouse owners and leaseholders with tenants. Its agents scrape the web for warehouse specifications—including construction dates, safety details, floorplans, and marketing materials—and compile profiles, pricing estimates, and virtual assets; customers can list spaces in minutes. The company deployed a web of 100 specialized agents on Google Cloud using the Gemini platform: Gemini Pro handles complex reasoning and logistics/matching logic, while Gemini Flash handles SMS and phone interactions. Cross-channel memory gives voice, SMS, email, and website conversations a unified context. Gemini 2.5 Flash image and Veo generate virtual tours from enhanced warehouse photos. The source does not name data stores or orchestration services; Google Cloud provides the partner platform, with enterprise security controls protecting proprietary data.
